metadata.authority_role: Announces the final proposed rule repealing the state 3SquaresVT rules (anticipated effective January 1, 2019): "Current program options and waivers will be maintained (subject to approval by the federal Food and Nutrition Service)." The department's response to comments (pages 2-3) says many or all program options are not part of the rules and that the 3SquaresVT Program Manual contains the state options and waivers. The bulletin does not itself state the child support election.
metadata.discovered_via: SNAP child support cited state sources; policyengine-us PR 9622
metadata.effective_date_note: The cover prints "CHANGES ADOPTED EFFECTIVE January 1, 2019" and marks the instruction "Proposed Regulation". Page 2 says copies of the final proposed rule were filed November 7, 2018, LCAR approved it November 29, 2018, the department expected to file the final rule on or before December 17, 2018, and "The anticipated effective date of the rule is January 1, 2019. This date is subject to change."
metadata.ocr_note: Page 1 is a scanned cover whose text layer is visible text drawn over the scan, not a new OCR run, and it misreads the cover: the row reads "EFFECTNE January 1. 2019" for "EFFECTIVE January 1, 2019", "273.l" for "273.1", and "__K__" for the X marking "Proposed Regulation", runs the reference table together, and keeps only fragments of "Sean Brown, Deputy Commissioner" and "Economic Services Division" printed under the signature. Pages 2 and 3 are text PDF pages.
metadata.official_publisher: Vermont Department for Children and Families
metadata.source_authority: Vermont Department for Children and Families, Economic Services Division
metadata.title: Vermont DCF Bulletin No. 18-06F, 3SquaresVT Rule Repeal
